title: Los Alamos insider: surfaces that solid objects pass through

tellings.quote: Uh, metal surfaces were um could be manipulated to like put things through, in or out

plain: Researchers at Los Alamos, the New Mexico weapons lab, learned that metal surfaces "could be manipulated to like put things through, in or out", according to a lab insider whose words are relayed by Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens. Woods passes it on second-hand without naming the insider; if true, it would point to a material technology that lets solid objects pass through walls.
